name: projul
description: Construction and service management for contractors

interface.longDescription: Give your office another set of hands without another hire. Connect Projul and let ChatGPT do the work in your account: leads, clients, estimates, change orders, schedule, notes, and files. Create an estimate, draft a change order from the walkthrough before the crew starts the extra work, pull the job file when a client asks what you agreed to, or slide the schedule when weather or a no-show blows the week. You stay in control.
defaultPrompt: What is in my pipeline right now? Group the projects by status.
Pull up Marcy Lawson before I call her, and show me her projects.
What is the total on the Lindqvist Exterior Siding estimate, and what are the line items?
